plan: A tank who can knock his target through a wall then drop his defences to hit it very hard.
aSurveiller: His R (All Out). He knocks you through a wall and chases you after dropping his defences: he becomes fragile, take advantage.
contrer: During his R he is less tanky: focus your damage on him.
Don't stand near walls: his R can cut you off from your team.
Avoid his 3rd Q: it pulls you towards him.
forces: Can isolate a target with his R.
faiblesses: Lower damage in his normal form.

sorts.P: His spells mark; next attack hits harder.
sorts.Q: Strike in a line; the 3rd pulls enemies in.
sorts.W: Charges, then knocks back and stuns.
sorts.R: Knocks back through a wall and turns offensive.
